messages:
Morgan: Hi team, Morgan here, first week in infra. I'm blocked on onboarding: need read access to GCP project `shared-datasets-7` and `iam.serviceAccountUser` on `etl-ci-sa@shared-datasets-7.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also need billing.viewer on billing account `redwood-apac-bill-12` and the ability to assume AWS role `arn:aws:iam::666555444333:role/RedwoodDataReadOnly` for S3 access. I tried opening the project and saw 403 on IAM and Billing pages. Who should I ping?

Leah: Welcome Morgan! For GCP we need your email and the project ID (looks correct). For AWS we need your SSO principal name. Billing.viewer is done by finance. Do you also need KMS decrypt on any SA keys to read datasets?

Morgan: Email: morgan@redwood.com, SSO: redwood/morgan. I might need to decrypt a few test artifacts with a key `projects/shared-datasets-7/locations/global/keyRings/analytics/cryptoKeys/ingest` for the job. If possible add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` scoped to the SA.

Leah: Thanks. Quick check: can you run and paste these (redact tokens)?
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy shared-datasets-7 --format=json

gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ingest --location=global --keyring=analytics --project=shared-datasets-7 --format=json

aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::666555444333:role/RedwoodDataReadOnly --role-session-name morgan-onboard || true
```

Morgan: Pasted outputs (redacted): project IAM shows only `group:data-admins@redwood.com`. KMS key policy shows only `serviceAccount:etl-ci-sa@shared-datasets-7.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `group:data-admins`. AWS assume-role returned AccessDenied.

cloud-security: FYI `shared-datasets-7` is under folder `data-platform` which limits resource locations to `europe-west1` only. APAC is blocked there. If you need APAC compute we can either request a project exception or create a new APAC project. Also KMS keys are tightly scoped; we'll need an explicit binding for the SA or grant you impersonation rights on the SA.

Morgan: I only need a short test in asia-southeast1 to validate downstream latency for a partner ingestion (under 4 hours). Temporary exception fine. For KMS, granting the SA the decrypt role is fine; I'll impersonate the SA from CI.

Leah: I'll open ticket CLOUD-9007 to request: add morgan@redwood.com to `data-iam-viewers`, grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on `etl-ci-sa@...`, add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to the SA for the key, and request a 4h project-level resource location exception to include `asia-southeast1`. Also will coordinate AWS group add to `data-crossacct-readonly`.

ops-bot: Ticket CLOUD-9007 created and assigned to infra and cloud-security. Temporary group `onboard-data-apac` will be created after approvals. ETA ~1 business day. :robot_face:

finance-bot: For short onboarding exceptions finance pre-approves up to $25. Please include estimated hours and instance size in CLOUD-9007.

cloud-security: Also note, we can't add KMS decrypt to individual users for production keys. Granting the SA decrypt role scoped to the key is the usual pattern. We'll add `etl-ci-sa@shared-datasets-7` to the key policy and ensure you can impersonate that SA.

Leah: I've updated CLOUD-9007 with the SA KMS change and the APAC exception for 4 hours. When infra provisions the `onboard-data-apac` group we'll add you and grant the minimal compute role so you can create a small VM.

Morgan: Thank you! Once the group and SA perms are in place I'll try the `gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=etl-ci-sa@shared-datasets-7.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and the AWS assume-role test. I'll post CLI outputs here if anything fails. :wave:
